independent_vlm_review.note: VLM output is a noisy audit. Direct inspection rejects missed background objects, reflections, and wingtip double-counts.

rtdetr_review.note: 640-pixel model used for targeted review; high-resolution predictions had more duplicate detections. These are reviewed predictions, not test reference labels.

grounding_dino_review.decision: No count changes. Tail prompts frequently detect the foreground airplane and its own tail as separate boxes, while missing small background tails.

targeted_vlm_review.decision: No additional changes; targeted VLM confused multiple foreground and background structures and did not reliably resolve occlusions. Direct image review retained.
